fact.scope: Ethiopia — Zawditu and Tafari regency within its existing editorial historical interval; office/capital is an institution of that entity, not evidence about every mapped polygon.
fact.note: LOC body describes Zawditu as empress after Iyasu deposition and dates her death to April 1930. The 1917–1929 bounded interval excludes accession/death uncertainty and makes no claim about sole effective authority.
